BusCongestion.use: Shows a data-bound memory bottleneck: LPDDR feeds a narrow bus into a large NPU; packets queue at the bus entrance; the NPU idles. Use for the memory-wall reveal.

props.flow: 0..1, fraction of NPU cells lit (the data-fed part); 0.25 = mostly idle NPU
props.queue: int 0..8, packets waiting at the bus entrance
props.label: optional short text (max 10 characters) above LPDDR

BusCongestion.beats: reveal: congestion grows (queue fills up); impact: idle NPU cells flash red

NpuArray.use: Shows a large NPU compute array working, to convey 100 TOPS.

props.load: 0..1, fraction of compute cells active (waves of light across the array)
props.label: short text above the array, default 100 TOPS
